verdict.rationale: Bugbot keeps much of its data on the user's own platforms. Its findings are posted as PR comments on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps, and project rules live as `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` markdown files in the repository, so both stay with the user if they leave. Accounts can also be deleted at any time. However, nothing documents an export path for Cursor-side data such as org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, learned rules, or analytics. Missing for 10: a documented data-export feature, export of Automations and learned rules, export of analytics and review history in open formats, and independent corroboration of a clean exit.
